(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define (step-range a b)
      (if (<= a b) (range a (+ b 1)) (reverse (range b (+ a 1)))))
    (define (trace a b)
      (let* ((r1 (first a)) (c1 (second a)) (r2 (first b)) (c2 (second b))
             (hpart (map (lambda (c) (list r1 c)) (step-range c1 c2)))
             (vpart (map (lambda (r) (list r c2)) (rest (step-range r1 r2)))))
        (append hpart vpart)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([frame (in-list (filter rect-border? (objects g 0)))])
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox frame))
             (inside-cells (filter (lambda (cell)
                                     (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
                                       (and (> r (first bb)) (< r (third bb))
                                            (> c (second bb)) (< c (fourth bb))
                                            (not (= v 0)) (not (= v (obj-color frame))))))
                                   (grid-cells g)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates (map third inside-cells))))
        (for/fold ([acc out]) ([color (in-list colors)])
          (let ((pts (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell)))
                          (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) inside-cells))))
            (if (= (length pts) 2)
                (paint-cells acc (trace (first pts) (second pts)) color)
                acc)))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= h 3) (>= w 3) (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (define (frame-area frame)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox frame)))
        (* (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1)
           (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))))
    (define (step-range a b)
      (if (<= a b) (range a (+ b 1)) (reverse (range b (+ a 1)))))
    (define (trace a b)
      (let* ((ordered (sort (list a b) cell<))
             (p (first ordered)) (q (second ordered))
             (r1 (first p)) (c1 (second p)) (r2 (first q)) (c2 (second q))
             (hpart (map (lambda (c) (list r1 c)) (step-range c1 c2)))
             (vpart (map (lambda (r) (list r c2)) (rest (step-range r1 r2)))))
        (append hpart vpart)))
    (define (inside-cells frame)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox frame)))
        (filter (lambda (cell)
                  (let ((r (first cell)) (c (second cell)) (v (third cell)))
                    (and (> r (first bb)) (< r (third bb))
                         (> c (second bb)) (< c (fourth bb))
                         (not (= v 0)) (not (= v (obj-color frame))))))
                (grid-cells g))))
    (define (points-of cells color)
      (sort (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell)))
                 (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) cells))
            cell<))
    (define (count-color cells color)
      (length (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color)) cells)))
    (define frames (filter rect-border? (objects g 0)))
    (define controller
      (first (sort frames (lambda (a b) (> (frame-area a) (frame-area b))))))
    (define controller-cells (inside-cells controller))
    (define controller-colors (remove-duplicates (map third controller-cells)))
    (define (hit-cells color)
      (let* ((pts (points-of controller-cells color))
             (route (if (= (length pts) 2) (trace (first pts) (second pts)) (list))))
        (filter (lambda (cell)
                  (let ((v (third cell)) (p (list (first cell) (second cell))))
                    (and (member p route)
                         (not (= v color))
                         (= (count-color controller-cells v) 1))))
                controller-cells)))
    (define controller-color
      (first (filter (lambda (color)
                       (and (= (length (points-of controller-cells color)) 2)
                            (= (length (hit-cells color)) 1)))
                     controller-colors)))
    (define controller-points (points-of controller-cells controller-color))
    (define relay-color (third (first (hit-cells controller-color))))
    (define stamped
      (paint-cells g
                   (trace (first controller-points) (second controller-points))
                   controller-color))
    (for/fold ([out stamped])
              ([frame (in-list (filter (lambda (item) (not (equal? item controller))) frames))])
      (let* ((cells (inside-cells frame))
             (pts (points-of cells relay-color)))
        (if (= (length pts) 2)
            (paint-cells out (trace (first pts) (second pts)) relay-color)
            out)))))
